name: NLIPairMatrix
description: CAMAv3 NLIPairMatrix: build sentence×memory NLI matrix (N×M×3) with bi-encoder pre-filter (top-K cosine), batch cross-encoder inference, ghost detection via max-column entailment threshold, attribution via argmax entailment/contradiction per row. Implemented in cama/matrix.py + cama/pipeline_v3.py.

content: TraceResult uses: ghost_memories (not ghosts), stale_memories (not stale), hallucinated_spans=[], hallucination_rate=0.0, memories_used. HallucinatedSpan uses start_char/end_char (not start/end) and token_scores: list[TokenScore]. split_sentences() returns list[tuple[str, int, int]] — unpack with [text for text, _s, _e in raw]. No from __future__ import annotations in Pydantic models (breaks forward refs).

name: CAMAv3Pipeline implementation
description: CAMAv3Pipeline.trace(): NLIPairMatrix.build() → span_attributions; hallucinated_spans=[], hallucination_rate=0.0; ghost_ids from matrix; stale from Diagnoser.detect_stale(); contradictions from Diagnoser.detect_contradictions() with nli_model; detection_method=attribution_method='NLIPairMatrix'

content: evaluate_scenario() and evaluate_case() accept Any pipeline type (not just CAMAv2) — use typing.Any for engine param so v3 pipeline works without import of CAMAv2 in evaluate.py

name: NLIPairMatrix mock testing
description: Construct NLIPairMatrix(model_name='mock-model') then replace m.nli = MagicMock(). NLIModel is lazily loaded (_model=None until _load() called), so construction is safe without transformers installed. Configure mock via m.nli.predict_batch.return_value = [{'contradiction': ..., 'entailment': ..., 'neutral': ...}]

name: CAMAv3Pipeline mock testing
description: Use CAMAv3Pipeline.__new__(CAMAv3Pipeline) to bypass __init__, then manually set p.matrix=MagicMock(), p.diagnoser=MagicMock(), p.nli=p.matrix.nli, p.similarity_threshold=0.20. Avoids loading NLIModel/transformers in tests entirely.
